title: Interpretation set, version 0.1
description: A ranked set of typed readings of one search question. Normative prose: specs/interpretation.md.

version.description: The interpretation schema version this set is written against, as MAJOR.MINOR. The pattern is the field's grammar, which every version shares; the enum is which version this schema defines. A document naming another version is not invalid, it is another version's business: specs/interpretation.md section 9 says what a consumer does with it.

query.description: The words the asker typed, when there were any. Absent when a producer built the set without a string.

targets.description: The content categories being asked about. Several targets are a union.

filters.description: Property constraints on the items. Several filters are a conjunction.

residual_words.description: Words no field claimed. Matched as text or by embedding inside the set the other fields select.

confidence.description: The producer's confidence in this reading, within this set only.

type.description: The content category type (Content Categories, table in its preamble).

id.description: The category slot value: absent for profile, the kind number for event-kind, a canonical naddr or nevent for dlist, the NIP-73 type for external.

property.description: A property named by the target's DList header schema, or by the NIP defining the event kind.

place.description: A geographic constraint. A geohash centre is required: near_observer is a display flag and never the constraint itself.

name.description: The place as the asker named it, for display. Never the constraint itself.

geohash.description: The centre of the radius, as a geohash cell. The compiler derives the covering cells.

near_observer.description: Display only: true when the asker said "near me" and the geohash beside it is the asker's own location, so a front end can say "near you". It never stands in for the centre — a producer that means "near me" resolves the centre itself.

time.description: A constraint on when the thing starts. At least one bound is required.

label.description: The window as the asker named it, for display. Never the constraint itself.

start_since.description: Unix seconds. The earliest start, inclusive.

start_until.description: Unix seconds. The latest start, inclusive.

observer.description: The pubkey whose web of trust ranks the results, as 64 lowercase hex. An npub is not an observer.

mode.description: Whose curation counts inside the observer's web of trust. What default means is G4.1's to define.

group.description: The group, as a canonical naddr or nevent for a DList, or 64 lowercase hex for a single pubkey.
